notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.WorldMap.cs shows the fullscreen map on the M binding: full-screen blackout, fullscreen scale-to-fit law, the 12-piece UI-WorldMap parchment chrome, the 12 continent/zone detail tiles from WorldMapArea directories, current-zone/continent resolution from the player's area, a player position blip, zone-name label, Zoom Out / Current Zone toggle, close X. Navigation and discovery features of the ref/Benilla are absent.
